challengeFindings.title: A consumer who sets `build.verify.maxAttempts: 3` after upgrading gets it silently lowered on every later upgrade, and `bkit check` exits 1 with DRIFT DETECTED until they give in
A staged `git mv src/a.test.ts docs/plans/x.ts` during Step 12 hides a code deletion from the tolerated-dirt check, so a push receipt is written for a HEAD whose test file never ran

While Step 12 waits on the tests lock, another worktree's full gate fails on the same commit; the lock-wait restore then deletes that `.failed` marker (and can put back an older receipt), so a later push reuses proof across a real failure
Every holistic limit pause now tells the owner "build holistic: attempt 3 of 2", because the pause fires only on exit 1 and passes the refused `:next` fix round as the attempt

`tests run --changed-since` with no changed files returns PASS but writes no `--artifact` and no clamp log, so the Step 8 `steps finish --artifact=build-group-gate-{GROUP}-<attempt>.md` that follows refuses with "does not exist"
